name: Amerel | Elegant Women’s Floral Perfume
description: Amerel, inspired by the timeless Dior J’adore, is a beautifully crafted women’s perfume designed for the modern, confident woman. The fragrance opens with a radiant burst of fresh citrus and fruity notes, offering a bright and uplifting introduction. As it blooms, an elegant floral heart of jasmine, ylang-ylang, and rose unfolds—soft, feminine, and irresistibly graceful. The base reveals warm touches of musk and sandalwood, adding depth, smoothness, and a long-lasting trail that feels both luxurious and comforting. With its high perfume-oil concentration, Amerel delivers excellent longevity, making it perfect for daily wear, formal occasions, weddings, and evenings out. Elegant, fresh, and sophisticated, this fragrance captures the true essence of femininity while delivering the premium J’adore experience—exclusively available at Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Citrus, Fruity Notes Heart Notes: Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Rose Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood Longevity: 7–9 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for everyday wear, events, and evening occasions Why Choose Amérel?
